name: ProGroCo | Moonmelon
description:
Lineage: Moonbow x Watermelon Zkittlez

Type: Hybrid

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, D-Limonene, Linalool 

Aroma: Peach, Herbal, Citrus, Spice 

Effects: Cerebral, Happy, Relaxed, Euphoric 

Prepare for an interstellar flavor experience with Moonmelon, a strain that's as cool as the dark side of the moon. The buds shimmer with a cosmic blend of greens and purples, promising an otherworldly visual spectacle. As you indulge, a sweet and fruity melody graces your palate, reminiscent of a melon picked under a lunar eclipse. Moonmelon's effects launch you into orbit with a perfect balance of relaxation and euphoria, as if you're floating weightlessly in the vastness of space. Elevate your senses with Moonmelon - because sometimes, the coolest things happen when the sun goes down on Earth and the moon takes center stage.
